name: Boku no Hanashi. Sensei no,
source:
Me and the teacher, a story of us.

Moonlight, white and blue. A night dyed in simple colors.
In this world, where even I am monochrome, my teacher, only my teacher, is a colorful being.

"I love you, teacher. Forever and ever."

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/12461]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我和老师，我们的故事。

月光，白色和蓝色。夜晚被简单的色彩染红。
在这个连我都是单色的世界里，我的老师，只有我的老师，是多彩的存在。

“我爱你，老师。永远。”

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/12461]Freem![/url]]
